dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave spline with low-magnitude curvature from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.2:1 ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convex arc radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary of the cranial region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short longitudinal pixel length with a thick proportional thickness relative to the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.
